issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Mycel
products.tagline: Bring one past deliverable. Mycel drafts every future one.
products.summaryZh: 带一份过往的交付成果。Mycel 会起草未来每一份。
products.descriptionZh: Mycel 负责运营你服务业务所销售的工作——客户、交付物、审批、发票。每项任务都在一次性的沙盒中运行，绝不持有任何凭据，未经你批准，任何内容都不会送达客户。每月 299 美元起，或免费自托管。
products.description: Mycel runs the work your service business sells - clients, deliverables, approvals, invoices. Each job runs in a disposable sandbox that never holds a credential, and nothing reaches a client until you approve it. From $299/mo, or self-host free.

products.name: Minicart
products.tagline: Launch your store. Let AI run the busywork.
products.summaryZh: 启动你的店铺。让 AI 处理繁琐事务。
products.descriptionZh: Minicart 帮助创客、创作者和经销商无需学习电商软件即可开设并运营在线商店。Minicart 为你提供一个商店和一个 AI 团队来协助运营。Sloane 管理你的店面，Milo 负责营销创作，Logan 处理物流和客户回复。只需与你的团队聊天，即可添加产品、更新库存、创建促销活动、发货等。用平实的语言告诉团队你的需求，审核他们的工作，然后继续发展你的业务。
products.description: Minicart helps makers, creators, and resellers launch and run an online store without learning ecommerce software. Minicart gives you a store and an AI team to help run it. Sloane manages your storefront, Milo creates marketing, and Logan handles logistics and customer replies. Add products, update inventory, create promotions, ship orders, and more by simply chatting with your team. Just tell your team what you need in plain language, review their work, and keep building your business.

products.name: Answers by Context.dev
products.tagline: Give it a research task + the JSON shape you want back.
products.summaryZh: 给它一个研究任务，并指定你希望返回的 JSON 结构。
products.descriptionZh: Context.dev 的 Answers 将网络研究简化为一次 API 调用。定义任务和所需的 JSON 结构，Answers 便会查找来源、研究网络，并返回带有来源 URL 的结构化数据。无需再拼凑搜索、抓取和 LLM 调用，即可构建数据丰富化流程、比较工具和研究代理。
products.description: Answers by Context.dev turns web research into a single API call. Define a task and your desired JSON structure. Answers finds sources, researches the web, and returns structured data with source URLs. Build enrichment pipelines, comparison tools, and research agents without stitching together search, scraping, and LLM calls.

products.name: Morsa Signals
products.tagline: GTM and AI visibility workflows for developer tools
products.summaryZh: 面向开发者工具的 GTM 与 AI 可见性工作流
products.descriptionZh: Morsa Signals 为开发者工具创始人和 GTM 团队提供实用的 GTM 与 SEO/GEO 工作流，一站式集成。你可以找到相关开发者进行规模化触达，识别潜在的首批用户和早期采用者，审查 AI 搜索系统如何理解你的网站，并初步了解值得追踪的竞争对手。每个工作流都从你的实际产品出发，产出聚焦、可执行的结果，而非泛泛的报告或数据库。
products.description: Morsa Signals gives developer-tool founders and GTM teams practical GTM and SEO/GEO workflows in one place. Find relevant developers for scaled outreach, identify potential first users and early adopters, audit how AI search systems understand your site, and get a first read on competitors worth tracking. Each workflow starts from your actual product and produces a focused, actionable result instead of a generic report or database.

products.name: Harbor
products.tagline: The Evernote alternative that puts its price in writing
products.summaryZh: 将价格写进条款的Evernote替代品
products.descriptionZh: 私密第二大脑：笔记、扫描件、PDF 和录音，支持 OCR 搜索，包括手写内容。一步导入 Evernote。原生支持 Mac、Windows、iPhone、iPad、Android、网页和 CLI。所有套餐均可完整导出。价格锁定 3 年，之后每年涨幅上限 10%。
products.description: A private second brain: notes, scans, PDFs and recordings, searchable with OCR, handwriting included. One-step Evernote import. Native on Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad, Android, web and CLI. Full export on every plan. Price locked 3 years, then a 10%/yr cap.

products.name: Termphin
products.tagline: SSH client with sessions that never drop.
products.summaryZh: SSH 客户端，会话永不中断。
products.descriptionZh: 即使手机锁屏、信号丢失或切换到移动数据，SSH 连接依然保持。一个小型代理在服务器上保持 shell 打开，让你回到同一屏幕。htop 和 vim 正常绘制。包含 SFTP、密钥、代码片段和隧道，免费。
products.description: SSH that survives a locked phone, a lost signal or a switch to mobile data. A small agent holds the shell open on the server and puts you back on the same screen. htop and vim draw properly. SFTP, keys, snippets and tunnels included, free.

products.name: Launchie 1.6.1
products.tagline: Launchpad Replacement for MacOS 27 Golden Gate
products.summaryZh: MacOS 27 Golden Gate 的 Launchpad 替代品
products.descriptionZh: Apple 在 macOS 26 中移除了 Launchpad，并且在 27 中也没有将其恢复。Launchie 把网格带了回来：按你的方式排列应用、无限文件夹、用于分隔应用页面的 Spaces，以及即时搜索。免费使用，Pro 为一次性购买。可在 Mac App Store 和 Homebrew 获取。
products.description: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS 26 and kept it out of 27. Launchie brings the grid back: arrange apps your way, unlimited folders, Spaces for separate app pages, and instant search. Free to use, Pro is a one-time purchase. Mac App Store and Homebrew.

products.name: ManyPI
products.tagline: 10x your revenue by finding your ideal customers
products.summaryZh: 通过找到理想客户，让收入增长十倍
products.descriptionZh: 定义你的理想客户。ManyPI 在实时网络上找到他们，验证其邮箱，确认其痛点和情感购买触发点，然后发送高度个性化的外联信息，将这些信号转化为销售。
products.description: Define your ideal customer. ManyPI finds them on the live web, verifies their email, validates their pain points and emotional buying triggers, then sends hyper-personalized outreach that turns those signals into sales.

products.name: Epismo OS
products.tagline: Keep your work when you switch AI tools
products.summaryZh: 切换AI工具时保留你的工作成果
products.descriptionZh: Epismo 将团队的 AI 工作保留在一个 Case 中：结果、背后的决策、评审以及下一步。切换 AI 工具或团队成员时无需重新说明。自动评审会对已保存的结果进行新一轮评审，标记问题，并保持原始内容不变。
products.description: Epismo keeps your team’s AI work in a Case: the result, the decisions behind it, reviews, and the next step. Switch between AI tools or teammates without a re-brief. Auto review gives a saved result a fresh review, flags issues, and leaves the original unchanged.

products.name: Embedful
products.tagline: Launch customer dashboards in minutes
products.summaryZh: 几分钟内启动客户仪表板
products.descriptionZh: Embedful 帮助 SaaS 团队在几分钟内构建并发布客户仪表板。连接现有数据，创建安全的面向客户的仪表板，并将个性化分析直接嵌入你的产品中。借助 Embedful，你无需自行构建和维护复杂的分析平台或仪表板基础设施，即可提供嵌入式分析。
products.description: Embedful helps SaaS teams build and launch customer dashboards in minutes. Connect your existing data, create secure customer-facing dashboards, and embed personalized analytics directly into your product. With Embedful, you can deliver embedded analytics without building and maintaining a complex analytics platform or dashboard infrastructure yourself.

products.name: SmartPause
products.tagline: The play/pause key, finally aimed at what's playing
products.summaryZh: 播放/暂停键，终于对准了正在播放的内容
products.descriptionZh: macOS 会把媒体键发送给它最后记住的应用，所以 YouTube 继续播放，Apple Music 却打开了。SmartPause 会找到实际正在输出音频的应用，并暂停它。两个应用同时播放？按一次切换，按两次播放/暂停。免费、开源，仅菜单栏。
products.description: macOS routes the media key to whatever it last remembers, so YouTube keeps playing and Apple Music opens. SmartPause finds the app actually outputting audio and pauses that. Two apps playing? One press switches, double press plays/pauses. Free, open source, menu bar only.

products.name: findable 2.0
products.tagline: Help your agency clients to #1 on ChatGPT, Google, Claude
products.summaryZh: 帮助你的代理客户在ChatGPT、Google、Claude上排名第一
products.descriptionZh: 帮助你的代理客户在ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini上排名第一
products.description: Help your agency clients get to #1 on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini

products.name: Aymo AI for Chrome
products.tagline: Free AI Sidebar in Your Browser with Tools and Top AI Models
products.summaryZh: 浏览器中的免费AI侧边栏，集成工具与顶级AI模型
products.descriptionZh: 免费的AI浏览器扩展，将50多个顶级AI模型和工具置于侧边栏，一键即达。GPT、Claude、DeepSeek、Kimi、Gemini及当前顶尖AI模型，尽集一处。适用于Chrome、Brave、Edge及其他Chromium内核浏览器。针对正在阅读的页面提问，使用AI快捷操作，创作或优化内容，在社交媒体上发布与回复，撰写及回复邮件，更快速高效地完成日常知识工作。
products.description: Free AI browser extension that puts 50+ top AI models and tools in a sidebar, one click away. GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Kimi, Gemini and top AI models available today, all in one place. Works on Chrome, Brave, Edge, and other Chromium browsers. Ask questions about the page you're reading, use AI quick actions, create or optimize content, post and reply on social media, write and reply to emails, and get your everyday knowledge work done faster and better.

products.name: Awnsy
products.tagline: Offline AI translator for Mac. Press ⌘C twice, done.
products.summaryZh: Mac 离线 AI 翻译器。按两次 ⌘C，搞定。
products.descriptionZh: Awnsy 是一款小巧的 macOS 菜单栏翻译工具。在任意应用中选中文本，连按两次 ⌘C，译文就会直接显示在窗口上方。对于无法选中的文本，比如图片、扫描版 PDF 或视频，只需框选区域，Awnsy 就能识别并翻译。翻译模型内置于应用中，在你的 Mac 上运行。无需账号，无需 API 密钥，可离线使用，翻译内容始终留在你的设备上。如果你更看重云端质量，也可以添加自己的 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 密钥。
products.description: Awnsy is a small menu bar translator for macOS. Select text in any app, press ⌘C twice, and the translation appears right over the window. For text you can't select, like images, scanned PDFs or video, drag a box around it and Awnsy reads and translates it. The translation model lives inside the app and runs on your Mac. No account, no API key, works offline, and what you translate stays on your machine. If you prefer cloud quality, add your own OpenAI or Anthropic key.

products.name: Creads
products.tagline: Your marketing, running on its own
products.summaryZh: 你的营销，自主运行
products.descriptionZh: 一支自我运转的完整营销团队。聊天与具备真实角色的智能体自动处理广告、自然流量与研究——它们创作、发布、优化。你得到的是结果，而非流程。免费试用3天。
products.description: A full marketing team that runs itself. Chat and agents with real roles handle ads, organic and research on autopilot — they create, publish, optimize. You get the outcome, not the workflow. Free 3-day trial.

products.name: Soar90™
products.tagline: Personal 30-60-90 day onboarding plan for any new job
products.summaryZh: 适用于任何新工作的个人30-60-90天入职计划
products.descriptionZh: 新工作？头90天至关重要，不能听天由命。Soar90™是唯一专为新员工打造的个人自助入职平台。从多个针对特定角色的路径中选择，定制你的计划，完成每日任务，记录成果，一键生成可用于评估的绩效报告，或自行创建。既可独立使用，也可配合任何公司入职流程。一次性购买。你已拿到这份工作，现在去征服你的头90天！同样适合招聘人员或雇主作为礼物赠送。
products.description: New job? The first 90 days are too important to leave to chance. Soar90™ is the only personal, self-guided onboarding platform built for new hires. Choose from multiple role-specific tracks, customize your plan, complete daily tasks, log wins, and generate review-ready performance reports in one click or create your own. Use it standalone or alongside any company onboarding. One-time purchase. You got the job, now crush your first 90 days! Also perfect as gift from recruiter or employer.

products.name: Chain Your Mac
products.tagline: The scrolling window manager for macOS.
products.summaryZh: macOS 的滚动窗口管理器。
products.descriptionZh: macOS 原生滚动窗口管理器：窗口置于无尽长条上，类似 Niri 或 PaperWM。触控板滑动、堆叠、无需 SIP，支持 macOS 13+。试试在线演示。
products.description: A native scrolling window manager for macOS: windows on an endless strip, like Niri or PaperWM. Trackpad swipe, stacks, no SIP, macOS 13+. Try the live demo.

products.name: The 101 Plays Itself
products.tagline: Five lanes of LA highway turned into an instrument
products.summaryZh: 洛杉矶高速公路的五条车道变成了乐器
products.descriptionZh: 一台位于Studio City的加州交通局实时交通摄像头，在浏览器中将US-101公路的画面化作音乐。就在此刻，南向101公路上的真实车流。每一辆越过标线的车都会奏响一个音符，而音乐就在车辆驶过时于你的浏览器中生成。
products.description: A live Caltrans traffic camera on the US-101 in Studio City, playing itself as music in your browser. Real traffic on the southbound 101, this minute. Every car that crosses the line plays a note, and the music is being made in your browser as they go past.

products.name: YABAI
products.tagline: Real Japanese slang, one giant word at a time
products.summaryZh: 真实的日语俚语，一次一个超长词汇
products.descriptionZh: 教科书教的日语，出了教室就用不上。YABAI 补上另一半：308 个真实俚语、网络用语和同人圈词汇，每个词一张卡，以巨大的日文字体为核心。每个词都有释义、真实例句、使用提醒（能放心用？只适合朋友间？要小心？）和一段来历——如果来源不确定，就如实说明，而不是编一个。全程用 Claude Code 中的 AI 智能体构建。支持 13 种语言，可离线使用。没有连续打卡，没有测试，没有经验值。
products.description: Textbooks teach Japanese that stops at the classroom door. YABAI is the other half: 308 real slang, internet and fandom words, each on a card built around giant Japanese typography. Every word has a meaning, a real example, a vibe check (safe to use? friends only? careful?) and a story — and when the origin is uncertain, it says so instead of inventing one. Built end to end with AI agents in Claude Code. 13 languages, works offline. No streaks, no tests, no XP.

products.name: Scrapboard Cloud 4
products.tagline: Digital family refrigerator door, now pocket-sized n synced
products.summaryZh: 数字家庭冰箱门，现在口袋大小，同步便捷
products.descriptionZh: Scrapboard系列拥有12年历史，Scrapboard Cloud 4将数字公告板的经典概念——重现家庭冰箱门般的温馨感——带到你的iOS设备上。这款应用与macOS版Scrapboard 4协同设计，让你通过iCloud账户在所有iPad、iPhone和Mac之间无缝同步和分享创意板。
products.description: With a 12-year heritage behind the Scrapboard series, Scrapboard Cloud 4 brings the classic concept of a digital bulletin board—recreating the cozy feel of a family refrigerator door—right to your iOS devices. Designed to work hand-in-hand with its macOS counterpart (Scrapboard 4), this app lets you seamlessly sync and share your creative boards across all your iPads, iPhones, and Macs using your iCloud account.
